title: HPControl Industrial Catalog
description: B2B industrial valves, solenoid valves & pneumatic actuators. Search & build a cart.
summary: B2B industrial valves, solenoid valves & pneumatic actuators. Search & build a cart.
offersHint: B2B industrial valves, solenoid valves & pneumatic actuators. Search & build a cart. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://hpcontrol.pl/agent/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_catalog
toolsPreview.description: Search the catalog for the selected storefront by name, SKU, EAN, model code or technical requirement. Bundle results expose public configuration_options; never infer compatibility from missing fields.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_catalog
toolsPreview.description: Look up up to 20 products by SKU using live Magento availability, visibility, prices and tier prices.

toolsPreview.name: get_product
toolsPreview.description: Get live product description, media, categories and bundle options, together with current price and availability.

toolsPreview.name: configure_product
toolsPreview.description: Validate public bundle selections and create a temporary configuration handle. Use only public_value_id values returned by search_catalog.

toolsPreview.name: create_cart
toolsPreview.description: Create an HPControl cart. Simple products use SKU; configurable bundle products require a configuration_handle.

toolsPreview.name: update_cart
toolsPreview.description: Replace the complete item set of an existing cart. Existing lines omitted from items are removed.

toolsPreview.name: get_cart
toolsPreview.description: Read the current items, totals and status of a cart.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_cart
toolsPreview.description: Cancel an active cart when the customer no longer wants it. This operation is idempotent.
